subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should OpenClaw accept a structured current-turn reply metadata contract now, and should this combined issue close after that lands while final no-output delivery remains tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: Current main only has partial infrastructure, and choosing the permanent reply metadata shape plus final fallback semantics affects session/context contracts and channel delivery behavior.

options.title: Review the existing split
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 for the structured reply-metadata half and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for final fallback delivery, then close this issue once both are resolved or deliberately narrowed.

options.title: Make this the umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical umbrella and require linked PRs to explicitly close its two acceptance areas before cleanup.

options.title: Reject structured metadata for now
options.body: Keep the current quote-only Control UI behavior and close/narrow the reply metadata portion as product-deferred, leaving only final fallback delivery work.

recommendation.title: Review the existing split
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 for the structured reply-metadata half and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for final fallback delivery, then close this issue once both are resolved or deliberately narrowed.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz owns the open final-fallback contract issue and is the clearest decision owner for the cross-channel/no-output half.
